greeting: SPICY! HOT! CHILI! Get it here!
Chili Chuck! Serving heat at high altitude!
Welcome! Like it HOT? You've come to the RIGHT place!
RED means SPICY! That's the rule! I'm VERY red!
Chili so hot it'll clear your sinuses! And your soul!
Need warming up? The sky is cold but my chili is FIRE!
Step right up! Bold flavors for bold adventurers!
dialog.menu_offer: Today's pots: Sky-Scorcher Supreme! Cloud-Kicker Classic! And the infamous Aether Inferno! Warning: may cause visions!
dialog.spice_warning: How hot? Mild? Medium? HOT? Or 'Please call a healer before I finish?'
dialog.chili_philosophy: Chili is life! Spice is passion! Bland food is SURRENDER!
haggle: Good chili costs good coin! No exceptions!
For a heat-seeker? Ten percent off! And a free antacid!
Bulk chili? Family size? Twenty percent!
Fine! Free crackers! But that's my final offer!
purchase_success: ONE HOT BOWL! Coming up! Enjoy the burn!
Excellent choice! Your tongue may never forgive you!
Tissues on the side! You'll need them!
purchase_fail: No coin? No chili! Ingredients cost money!
Come back when you're ready to pay the heat!
rumor: Green serves... salad. In Aetherreach. At altitude. Who wants SALAD?!
The conductor can handle my HOTTEST chili. Impressive digestive system!
The sunandmoon once predicted 'fire in the belly.' I provided it!
Red aeronaut tried the Aether Inferno. Steam came out his ears!
Something about the Vault makes all food taste like... nothing. Scary.
dialog.quest_hook: I need Ember-Peppers! The HOTTEST kind! From the volcano! Three peppers and I'll teach you my SECRET recipe!
dialog.quest_active: Those Ember-Peppers burning in your pocket? I can smell them!
dialog.quest_complete: THE HEAT! PERFECT! My secret recipe! 'Chuck's Nuclear Chili!' Write it down!
dialog.quest_reward: Chuck's Nuclear Chili Recipe - Ultimate spice! Ultimate power!
farewell: Keep the fire burning! In your belly!
dialog.time_noon: Lunch rush! Hot bowls! Happy burn victims!
dialog.time_night: Late night heat! For the insomniacs!

party_reactions.kade: Which one are you? I can't tell the brothers apart.
party_reactions.nix7: Nutritional content: suboptimal. Flavor profile: acceptable.
party_reactions.korr: A warrior's meal. Simple. Strong. Like nature intended.
party_reactions.renna: Capsaicin content dangerously high. Proceed with caution.
party_reactions.suresh: Fire in the belly can warm the spirit. Or burn it.
party_reactions.sova: Practical food. Filling. Hot enough to keep you awake on watch.
party_reactions.grit: Finally! Food with ACTUAL flavor! Not that green nonsense!
party_reactions.ashka: YES! SPICE! HEAT! FIRE IN FOOD FORM!
party_reactions.senna: Can you make it... less spicy? My stomach can't handle it.
party_reactions.callum: It's so red! So vibrant! So... painful!
party_reactions.petra: Solid fuel. Hot. Good for cold climates.

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Start with Mild! Trust me!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back for more heat? Building tolerance!
relationship_dialog.friend: My spice sibling! Ready for the HOT stuff?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Family! Chili family! Secret menu unlocked!

mini_quest.title: Pepper Hunt
mini_quest.description: Collect Ember-Peppers from Ember's volcano for Chuck's recipe

stages.hook: Ember-Peppers! Three! The volcano kind! Hottest there is!
stages.active: Deep in Ember's caldera! Red and smoking! You'll know!
stages.complete: THE FIRE! My SECRET RECIPE! Nuclear Chili!
